title: Conflicting Service Credit Precedent Under New SLA Policy
question: What service credit amount should Aisha offer Bridgewater Dynamics, and through what process?

contributor.name: Aisha Patel
contributor.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Enterprise account management, SLA enforcement, escalation decisions

choices: No credit until the formal exception process is followed — the October credit was improperly approved and cannot serve as precedent.
15% flat credit per the MSA custom addendum (Section 8.4), processed through CRM Exception Request workflow with Director+ approval.
10% per hour of downtime (40% total, capped at 30%) via the Exception Request workflow, per the current Confluence policy v3.
15% credit matching the October precedent (ticket #38921) as goodwill to maintain the relationship, approved by VP Sales.
